historical_binding_policy: Historical source/review hashes identify original reviewed bytes. SOURCE_EXPORT_MAP.json identifies current privacy-normalized copies; current delivered bytes are bound by STAGE_FILE_MANIFEST.json and the repository inventory. Historical ledgers are not current-export checksums.
reference_census: SOURCE_REFERENCE_CENSUS.json records all 75 documentary SHA-256 occurrences (47 unique), resolved to selected original/public identities or already-public mapped sources. SOURCE_NAMED_REFERENCE_CENSUS.json supplies 103 filename-reference resolutions. These syntax censuses do not claim recursive re-audit of every earlier theorem.

historical_checksum_ledgers.handling: Preserved as historical evidence. Do not silently retarget original source hashes or claim they equal changed public copies.

review_scope: B main analytic review binds the candidate and comparison correction; a separate addendum reviews terminal-pair-only minimax u/2 and precision qualification.
Sensitivity v1 review, seed correction, v2 change/render verification and later same-port reviews are separate, preserved artifacts. Historical pending wording remains chronological.
The no-BOS main independent review binds v3; section 6 specifically checks v4 preprocessing and source caveats. This is not a new full v4 proof review.
All reviews are scoped independent LLM reviews, not external peer review, formal validation or novelty certification.
code_export_policy: Four archived programs and all three numerical archives remain byte-exact. build_v2.py has four approved nonmathematical substitutions in two string constants, matching mapped report language; numeric literals and all other AST structure are unchanged. It was not executed.

retained_record_scope.no_bos_inputs: All binary words N=3..8 at eta 1/4 and 1/32 in the retained record set.
missing_original_traces: raw or centered logits and attention weights
retained_record_scope.clarification: Scalar b/c budgets, maximal copy error and global gate flags are not internal trace arrays. A separately generated later run would not recover contemporaneous logs. FOL046 explicitly preserves this boundary.

earlier_missing_history: Previous-stage overwritten D’Angelo audit bytes and original Route B path-search logs remain unavailable. This stage does not reconstruct them.
scope_boundary: Existing public files remain unchanged except mechanical inventory addition. Only 11 selected already-public dependency identities are checked, not the entire historical source graph. No original archived program, RNG or model initialization is run by the new default helper.
